Package solvers

package solvers
Solution algorithms of JMVA. JMVA solves open, closed and mixed product form queueing networks: open models with the classical queueing network algorithms and closed models with the exact algorithms MVA (Mean Value Analysis, in a stabilized version for load dependent stations), RECAL (Recursion by Chain Algorithm), MoM (Method of Moments), CoMoM (Class Oriented Method of Moments) and TreeMVA, as well as the approximate AMVA algorithms Chow, Bard-Schweitzer, Linearizer, DeSouza-Muntz Linearizer and AQL (Aggregate Queue Length).

    Priority support of the JMVA solvers: Priority MVA (P-MVA) and Related Workload Approximation (RWA) calculators for models with priority classes.

    Queueing network model of JMVA: stations, classes, service demands and visits used by the exact and approximate solution algorithms.
    solvers.singleSolverAlgorithms
    Single class solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, stabilized exact MVA for load dependent stations, open model solution and related single class solvers.
    solvers.utilities
    Utilities of the JMVA solvers, such as the processing capacity checker used to verify that the workload can be processed by the network.

    SolverMultiClosedCoMoM
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact CoMoM (Class Oriented Method of Moments) algorithm [Cas09], one of the exact solution techniques available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks.
    SolverMultiClosedMoM
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact MoM (Method of Moments) algorithm [Cas06][Cas11], one of the exact solution techniques available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks.
    SolverMultiClosedRECAL
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact RECAL (Recursion by Chain Algorithm) algorithm [CG86], one of the exact solution techniques available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks.
    SolverMultiIterative
    Iterative multiclass solution algorithm of JMVA, base of the approximate iterative solvers.
